entries.reason: nothing steps a physics simulation on this port: no SCNPhysicsBody is carried, so gravity, speed, the time step, a behavior and the contact delegate have nothing to act on. What an archive holds is read: coin.scn keys 'physicsWorld' on the scene to a nested SCNPhysicsWorld whose gravity (0, 1.75, 0) decodes exactly against a macOS SceneKit oracle, not the class default (0, -9.8, 0)
entries.effect: gravity/speed/timeStep/contactDelegate and the behaviors are kept as decoded or set and read back, and never act: nothing falls, collides or calls the contact delegate; the first time an application sets one of them or adds a behavior, the log says so once. rayTest/contactTest/convexSweep answer an empty array, which is the true answer with no body to hit, and updateCollisionPairs has no pairs to update. The archive's 'scale' key (float, seen at 1.0) has no public property to carry it to and is not decoded; 'scene' is a back-reference to the owning SCNScene, not a settable property, and is not decoded either

entries.reason: the NSValue(SceneKitAdditions) category this port implements in NSValue+SceneKit.m, boxing SCNVector3/SCNVector4/SCNMatrix4 for NSValue the way the real SDK header declares; check_registry flagged these six as built with no registry entry (classes were registered in this same pass, the category on an existing class was not, since it is not a class)
entries.effect: valueWithSCNVector3:/valueWithSCNVector4:/valueWithSCNMatrix4: box the struct via +[NSValue valueWithBytes:objCType:]; the getters read back only when objCType matches, defaulting to zero (SCNVector3/4) or SCNMatrix4Identity otherwise, never garbage
entries.source: measured directly against the release cache ladder, not read off sdk-introduced.json (which lists NSValue.SCNMatrix4Value/SCNVector3Value/SCNVector4Value as properties, not the category methods themselves, and carries no ios() version for them either): the literal selector strings valueWithSCNVector3:/valueWithSCNVector4:/valueWithSCNMatrix4:/SCNVector3Value/SCNVector4Value/SCNMatrix4Value are absent from the 7.1.2 armv7 dyld_shared_cache and present, all six together, in the 8.0 one -- checked by raw string search (strings -a | grep -xF), with a nonsense-selector negative control confirming the search does not over-match. objc.inventory (modules/apple/objc.lua) was tried first and returned ABSENT for all six at every release including 10.0.1, where the category demonstrably exists (macOS SceneKit oracle already used it in an earlier turn) -- it does not merge a category compiled in one image (SceneKit.framework) onto a class defined in another (NSValue, in Foundation), so it is not fit for measuring a cross-image category and this entry does not rely on it
